summary: Pre-resolved 'action: auto_descope_to_<spec>' markers with no lever-0 record bypass the mandatory vectorize-first step (SKILL.md 5.bis(a) bullet 1, workflow.yaml marker fields, markers.md).
evidence: Worktree SKILL.md:2439-2441 (unconditional advance on auto_descope, no lever-0 qualification; bullet 3 'Any OTHER pre-resolution' textually excludes auto_descope); workflow.yaml:1700-1701 + markers.md:83 (unconditional 'continues with the descoped sweep' placed before the pre-resolved/UNRESOLVED clause); contradicts the shipped canonical pivot rule at workflow.yaml ~845 ('any other resolution' without lever-0 -> UNRESOLVED, coverage parenthetical names poster-side pre-resolution) and plan v3 MF-B ('any resolution'; 'trust any action: field' explicitly REJECTED). Arrival shape is real: legacy corpus markers in #474/#488/#667/#697 carry auto_descope with no lever-0 record; #488's is an implementer self-descope (auto_descope_to_r_samples=2) on a CPU-dominated per-cell basis. Fix: qualify the auto-descope branches on a lever-0 record in the component chain (else UNRESOLVED -> step 2), mirrored in workflow.yaml fields + markers.md regen. Origin: epm:code-review-codex v1 Major; upheld by epm:review-reconcile v1.
